text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Moscow will not remain "calm" if NATO soldiers replace U.N. peacekeepers in Macedonia, commentary on the visit of Russian representative to the U.N. Sergei Lavrov to Skopje.
- Macedonia and Salvador establish diplomatic relations.
- Three hundred Macedonian citizens win U.S. emigrant visas in a lottery.
- Russian natural gas to reach Macedonia next month. The public company GAMA, set up last week by the Macedonian government, will operate with the gas.
